tool_input.description: Compare shared blocks between backup.sh and rotate.sh

result:
Done. All 8 tests pass via `bash tests/run_tests.sh`, and I verified end-to-end that `rotate --keep=2` on 3 archives deletes only the oldest, dry runs delete nothing, spaces pass through `backup.sh → verify.sh`, and `--help`/`-q`/`-n`/`--keep N`/`--keep=N`/missing-dest exit codes behave as before.

- `rotate.sh` — bug fix: the sorted list is oldest-first, so surplus is now the first `total - keep` lines (`head -n`) instead of `tail -n +"$keep"` (which deleted the newest), and `total == keep` now exits with "nothing to rotate" (`-le` instead of `-lt`). Also now sources `lib/common.sh` and calls `parse_common_options "$@"`.
- `verify.sh` — bug fix: the sidecar file name is now taken as everything after the digest's separator whitespace (was `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated `my backup-…` to `my`), and the digest comparison is quoted (`[[ "$expected" == "$actual" ]]`). Same shared-lib sourcing.
- `lib/common.sh` — new file holding the shared option-parsing block (`parse_common_options`, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `DEST/NAME/KEEP/QUIET/DRY_RUN/ARGS` init, `--keep` validation) and `resolve_dir`, with a double-sourcing guard like `lib/log.sh`. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` left untouched (noted in the header comment that their inline copies must stay in sync).
- `tests/run_tests.sh` — two new tests: verify reports `ok` for an intact archive whose name contains a space (rc 0), and `rotate --keep 2` with exactly 2 archives deletes nothing.

One note: my scratch file `tests/sanity-checks.sh` is still in the repo — `rm` needed a permission approval — delete it if you don't want it.
